annotations.title: Get the price of a designed voice

description: FREE quote for designing a reusable voice for your owned actors, including Leon and Bianca, using Soclo. Show the exact price and get the owner’s approval before soclo_hosted_voices_design. Keep the input text unchanged: the design must carry the same input, the returned quoteId and expectedCredits. Pricing unavailable stops new design, even for exempt owners. No paid fallback or voice allocation cap.
name: soclo_hosted_voices_quote
